name: HEGROUP
recent: HE Group Berhad 近期公告主要涉及董事兼大股东 Haw Chee Seng 在闭门期及闭门期外的股份增持。最新财报显示，2026年6月30日止季度营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。
notable: 董事兼大股东 Haw Chee Seng 在2026年10月至11月期间多次增持公司股份。
公司2026年6月30日止季度净利达510万令吉，净利率11.1%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为4614万令吉，环比增长75.8%，同比增长44.0%；净利为510万令吉，环比增长99.2%，同比增长61.3%；净利率从上一季度的9.8%提升至11.1%。

recent_en: HE Group Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve share acquisitions by Director and substantial shareholder Haw Chee Seng during and outside the closed period. The latest financial results show revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 increased both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Director and substantial shareholder Haw Chee Seng acquired company shares multiple times between October and November 2026.
The company's net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 reached RM5.1 million, with a net margin of 11.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM46.14 million, up 75.8% QoQ and 44.0% YoY; net profit was RM5.10 million, up 99.2% QoQ and 61.3% YoY; net margin improved to 11.1% from 9.8% in the previous quarter.
